purpose: Authorize one isolated review-controller bootstrap that implements the provider-maintenance classification already defined by the merged Local Qwen authority without modifying the Local Qwen provider itself. The controller slice is reviewed by the existing independent provider before merge; only after this controller slice is merged may the separate provider-maintenance branch use the merged bootstrap contract.

requiredChange.summary: Teach the trusted exact-head review controller and verifier to recognize only the already-authorized providerMaintenanceBootstrap contract from merged live main and to publish a distinct provider-neutral bootstrap result. The implementation must not change the Local Qwen workflow, provider identity, provider status, model/runtime/policy pins, substantive review rules or product code.

requiredInvariants: The implementation reads provider-maintenance authority only from a source-controlled scope already present on merged live main; PR-head authority data cannot grant itself bootstrap eligibility.
The controller bootstrap branch cannot change .github/workflows/local-qwen-independent-review.yml or any product/runtime file.
The controller implementation itself cannot use providerMaintenanceBootstrap for admission and must receive genuine independent exact-head review under the pre-bootstrap verifier.
Bootstrap eligibility remains restricted to the exact provider-maintenance branch and exact allowed implementation paths declared by the merged upstream authority.
A bootstrap success is a governance maintenance classification only. It is not Codex, Copilot, Octopus or Local Qwen independent review authority and must not be described as such.
Existing Codex, Copilot, Octopus and Local Qwen exact-head review paths remain unchanged and fail closed under their current identity, status and immutable-run checks.
Owner self-audit, zero unresolved current threads, zero active CHANGES_REQUESTED, exact live head, exact live-main ancestry and required CI remain mandatory for the provider-maintenance bootstrap.
The provider-maintenance bootstrap remains ineligible for substantive or product PRs, including PR #5349.

After the separate Local Qwen provider repair merges, PR #5349 must forward-sync to exact current main and obtain a fresh strengthened Local Qwen exact-head review; no bootstrap classification transfers to it.
No product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data, dependency, lockfile or production runtime behavior changes are authorized.
Production hosting remains REG_RU_VPS_ONLY and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
